// The FlatBuffers schema for configuring Firebase desktop support. Right now
// it is defined as a subset of JSON format for Firebase Android platform. App
// developer can download google-services.json from Firebase console and use it
// for desktop development.
// All FlatBuffers class is under namespace firebase::fbs to avoid contaminating
// the top namespace firebase. Field name must match what is used in the .json
// file and preferably table name is the Camel case of the field.
namespace firebase.fbs;
// Below are types to specify each field.
// Project information.
table ProjectInfo {
  project_number: string;
  firebase_url: string;
  project_id: string;
  storage_bucket: string;
// General app client information.
table AndroidClientInfo {
  package_name: string;
table ClientInfo {
  mobilesdk_app_id: string;
  android_client_info: AndroidClientInfo;
table AndroidInfo {
  package_name: string;
  certificate_hash: string;
table OAuthClient {
  client_id: string;
  client_type: int;
  android_info: AndroidInfo;
table ApiKey {
  current_key: string;
// Services information.
table AnalyticsProperty {
  tracking_id: string;
table AnalyticsService {
  status: int;
  analytics_property: AnalyticsProperty;
table AppInviteService {
  status: int;
table AdsService {
  status: int;
  test_banner_ad_unit_id: string;
  test_interstitial_ad_unit_id: string;
  analytics_service: AnalyticsService;
table Services {
  analytics_service: AnalyticsService;
  appinvite_service: AppInviteService;
  ads_service: AdsService;
// Top level app client information.
table Client {
  client_info: ClientInfo;
  oauth_client: [OAuthClient];
  api_key: [ApiKey];
  services: Services;
// This is the top level type to specify a configuration file.
table GoogleServices {
  // Project information.
  project_info: ProjectInfo;
  // App information.
  client: [Client];
  // Project version string.
  configuration_version: string;
root_type GoogleServices;

constant const bool clearTarget0 = mask & 1;

constant const bool clearTarget3 = mask & 8;                    
constant const bool clearTarget4 = mask & 16;                   
constant const bool clearTarget5 = mask & 32;

struct FragmentOut                                              
{                                                               
    float4 col0 [[color(0), function_constant(clearTarget0)]];  
    float4 col1 [[color(1), function_constant(clearTarget1)]];  
    float4 col2 [[color(2), function_constant(clearTarget2)]];  
    float4 col3 [[color(3), function_constant(clearTarget3)]];  
    float4 col4 [[color(4), function_constant(clearTarget4)]];

    float4 col7 [[color(7), function_constant(clearTarget7)]];  
};                                                              
fragment FragmentOut clear_fs(V2F input [[stage_in]])           
{                                                               
    FragmentOut out;                                            
    if (clearTarget0)                                           
        out.col0 = input.color;                                 
    if (clearTarget1)                                           
        out.col1 = input.color;                                 
     if (clearTarget2)                                          
        out.col2 = input.color;                                 
    if (clearTarget3)                                           
        out.col3 = input.color;                                 
    if (clearTarget4)                                           
        out.col4 = input.color;                                 
    if (clearTarget5)                                           
        out.col5 = input.color;                                 
    if (clearTarget6)                                           
        out.col6 = input.color;                                 
    if (clearTarget7)                                           
        out.col7 = input.color;                                 
    return out;

Adapter
Initialization Status
This can cause ads to not load and display.
This generally means the SDK is included in multiple targets. 
In the Unity IDE, follow these steps to fix this:
1. Update the External Dependency Manager to at least version 1.2.164.
2. Open the iOS Resolver Settings (Assets > External Dependency Manager> iOS Resolver > Settings).
3. Ensure "Add use_frameworks! to Podfile" and "Always add the main target to Podfile" are unchecked.
Here are two methods that can resolve this:
1. CocoaPods Integration - Ensure there is only one target in your Podfile, and remove "use_frameworks!", if present.
2. Manual Integration - In your app's xcodeproj file, ensure AppLovinSDK is only included in one of the targets under "Frameworks, Libraries, and Embedded Content".
